titulo.alumno: Returning a product and explaining the reason

intro: In this lesson you will practice returning a product and explaining the reason.

texto: Compare price, quantity and warranty; when making a complaint, explain the reason and ask for a specific solution.

frases.estudio: Θέλω να επιστρέψω το πουκάμισο, επειδή το μέγεθος δεν μου ταιριάζει.
frases.alumno: I want to return the shirt because the size doesn't fit me well.

frases.estudio: Θα ήθελα ψωμί χωρίς γλουτένη και ένα κιλό ντομάτες.
frases.alumno: I would like gluten-free bread and a kilo of tomatoes.

frases.estudio: Το δεύτερο προϊόν κοστίζει λιγότερο, αλλά έχει μικρότερη εγγύηση.
frases.alumno: The second product costs less, but has a shorter warranty.

pregunta.texto: Listen to the complaint and locate the reason or the solution requested.
